'''Bogles''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Can spawn naturally, once a [[Colony]] with at least 30 points exists in the dimension, individually with a spawnweight of 1.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Bogles are Flying Stealth Bomber units with additional melee capabilities.
*Bogles can shoot highly explosive projectiles.
**Bogles will not do this if their target is midair.
*Bogles have a damaging, immunity frame ignoring, melee aura.
*Bogles will occasionally swoop down from above their target. 
*Bogles can spawn [[Succor|Succors]].
*Bogles can go completely invisible. This invisibility is disrupted when it shoots, takes damage, or if its health goes below 40% of its max health. Succors spawned during this invisibility will spawn with the invisibility effect for 3 seconds.
*Bogles can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 15, with a 20 tick cooldown and a 5 Block range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Bogles, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Bogles are also known as '''Lencia''' in the Mod Files.
*"Bogle" is a dialectal English word for a specter or goblin, having a similar meaning to "haunter" or "wraith".
